PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__Me.ConfigLabel: PainterlyNPR - The Technical Pen Calibration Sheet
PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__Me.ConfigNote: A sheet of the four technical pens drawn through the engine's own stroke synthesis and ink pass at a print resolution: straight, vertical, diagonal and curved lines, crossings and a small window for each pen, labelled in the lettering pen, with 10 mm and 100 mm marks to check a print with a ruler. Every position is millimetres from the sheet's top-left corner.

PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__Sh.Note: The resolutions the sheet is drawn and measured at, and its ink: full (Alpha above 1 is clamped to full along the whole line, so coverage is geometry) and soft black on white paper for printing.
PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__Sh.ExportDpiNote: Adam, 30-Oct-2026: "Documents should be 300 dpi". The panel also offers 600 dpi, for a measuring loupe
PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__Sh.AlphaNote: The pen's ink is (0.72 + 0.28 x pressure) x Alpha: from 1/0.72 up it is full everywhere, so the measured coverage is the line's area
PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__Sh.Title: PAINTERLYNPR - TECHNICAL PEN CALIBRATION
PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__Sh.Subtitle: STAEDTLER MARS MATIC 700 - SHEET {W} x {H} mm - PRINT AT 100% (ACTUAL SIZE, NO FIT TO PAGE)
PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__Sh.SubtitleNote: {W} and {H} are the sheet's own width and height in millimetres (the main config's Sheet)

PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__La.Note: One row per pen, RowTopsMm down the sheet. In each row: the label, a horizontal line, a vertical one, three diagonals, a circle, a cross and a saltire, and a small window with its bars and cill. Lengths in millimetres, laid out on a DesignMm sheet and centred on the real one (A3 or any other); the corner marks stay at the real sheet's corners.
PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__La.HorizontalNote: From x, to x, at the row's top plus y: 100 mm long
PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__La.VerticalNote: At x, from the row's top plus y, to plus y: 25 mm
PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__La.DiagonalsNote: Each from (x, the row's top + 27) rising at the angle in degrees, DiagonalMm long
PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__La.CircleNote: Centre x, the row's top + y, and radius
PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__La.CrossNote: Centre x, the row's top + y, and half the arm
PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__La.WindowNote: Its frame from (x0, top + y0) to (x1, top + y1): a mullion, a transom and a cill 2 mm proud each side

PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__Ru.Note: Drawn with the base pen, for a ruler or a measuring loupe: a 100 mm scale ticked every millimetre, a 10 mm square, a 100 mm upright scale, and corner marks 6 mm in from each corner.
PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__Ru.ScaleTicksNote: Tick lengths: every millimetre, every 5 mm, every 10 mm
PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__Ru.SquareAtNote: Left, top and side: clear of the last pen row (which ends at 179 mm) and of the 100 mm scale's labels
PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__Ru.CornerNote: Inset and arm length of the corner marks

PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__Me.Note: How the pens are measured. Geometry: the ribbon half-widths stroke synthesis writes, which must equal the pen's to GeometryTolPx. Raster: the ink's coverage summed across a line (the box filter makes that its width in pixels) on its middle, kept clear of its ends by EndClearMm, within RasterTolMm. Every base-buffer pixel must lie inside the ink (ContainTol, in 1/255ths).
PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__Me.RasterTolNote: 5 microns: a twenty-sixth of the base pen. The coverage of a line is exact to well under a micron; the tolerance is for the 8-bit ink
PainterlyNPR__PenCalibration__Config__Me.HalfInkNote: A profile-pen line at this ink, drawn off the sheet's content, must peak at this ink: the base beneath it never darkens it
